metadata.description: Task-routing plugin: decide whether to delegate, what shape to use, and which model tier and reasoning effort to spend.

plugins.name: intelligent-delegate
plugins.description: Routes a task to the cheapest execution shape that still gets it right — inline, a single subagent, or a Workflow fan-out — and picks the model tier and reasoning effort to match. Ships five pre-tiered agent definitions (mechanical, worker, reviewer, builder, judge) so a reasoning-effort choice is actually reachable from the Agent tool, which has no effort parameter.
